headline: Ce domenii finanțează cel mai mult IFN-urile? Serviciile, comerțul și agricultura sunt în top
summary: Services, trade and agriculture rank as the sectors most financed by Romania's non-bank financial institutions. Credit to construction, trade and services has roughly doubled over five years.
why: Non-bank financial institutions are lenders outside the banking system, and their sector exposure shows where credit growth is concentrated in the Romanian economy.
